headline: TILT leaves the lone pilot: lean to steer MARBLE RUSH and the COMET DRIFT pair
lede: The PADTYPES tail closed its tilt slice. Phone motion now drives three more titles through the same analog pipeline the stick uses — and the harness proves the lean really reaches the marble, not just the pill.

notes.text: #3129 tilt grants: MARBLE RUSH gets STICK/TILT/D-PAD and COMET DRIFT + HD get STICK/TILT/FULL — supports-only, defaults stay derived. One 2-axis lean steers AND throttles; the karts keep DRIFT as a chip.
padtypeplay grew a deterministic input-reach proof for holder-path games: same seed, 90 ticks, a held 10-degree lean diverges the sim hash, and RE-CENTER replays the neutral trajectory byte-for-byte.
One tail stays human: the real-iPhone ENABLE TILT permission tap can't be proven from Chrome — #3129 stays open for a hands-on device check.
